name: Mara Detron
tradeable: unranked only, no Forma or Catalyst

groups.activity: crack Void Relics, trade Prime parts for Ducats
groups.mode: squad of four for more reward picks

rows.label: Ducats
rows.note: trade Prime parts and blueprints at any Relay Ducat Kiosk except Maroo's Bazaar

rows.label: Mara Detron
rows.note: arrives built and ready to equip; no Foundry step
rows.alt: or a TennoCon relay visit with Baro's Relay Ticket

conditions: Baro's stock changes every visit; the Mara Detron comes back roughly two to three times a year, and PC and console can be out of sync.
MR 9 is needed to equip it, and to receive it in a trade.
bonuses: It's separate Mastery from the base Detron and the Tenet Detron; owning the Tenet doesn't cover it.

disclosures.title: manual trigger
disclosures.body: It's semi-auto and out-fires your clicking once fire-rate mods are on. Enable the setting to fire manual-trigger weapons continuously, or bind fire to the mouse wheel.
